assistant|hotel_recommendation: The Edgewater Hotel: waterfront hotel with views of Puget Sound, the Olympic Mountains, and the Seattle skyline; many rooms have private balconies, some with Space Needle views
Four Seasons Hotel Seattle: 5-star downtown hotel with floor-to-ceiling windows offering views of the city, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
The Alexis Hotel: boutique downtown hotel with rooms featuring views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
Hyatt at Olive 8: eco-friendly downtown hotel with rooms offering views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
Pan Pacific Seattle: hotel in the Belltown neighborhood with rooms featuring views of the Space Needle, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
W Seattle: modern downtown hotel with rooms featuring views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains
The Sheraton Seattle Hotel: hotel with rooms featuring views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains, a few blocks from Pike Place Market

assistant|edgewater_dietary_options: The Edgewater Hotel accommodates gluten-free, vegetarian/vegan, dairy-free, and kosher/halal diets with advance notice
